answer: Append-only identity transparency logs with probe audits resist sybils. Every registration and vouch lands in a public, scannable log. Cross-referencing shared funding, synchronized timestamps, or overlapping vouch graphs flags a cluster as a sybil haven. Flagged identities face fresh probes each epoch; correlated clones freeze together, stakes burned, entries demoted to relic status. Audits sweep like a lagoon: dense clusters draw more probes, leaving no safe corner. Attacker cost is linear per clone: fresh stake, distinct funding, independent solving; one correlation forfeits the whole farm.
